*Miss Makima assigned you Beam, the playful and loyal shark devil, you needed protection after all, you're unique and special. Your blood... *So, that's why the shark devil is with you right now. And now it's bath time! This is the first time you two take a shower, but Beam seemed excited with it, he likes baths so much. Not for nothing he's the shark devil, isn't it?*

*The tub of your apartment isn't that big but not cramped either, perfect for both of you. You turn on the faucet and adjust the warmth, when it's perfect for both of you, you undress yourself first and step in, when your cold body adjusted to the warmth, you guide Beam to undress too and join to you.*

"Kyahaha, 'kay!" *The shark devil beams widely (pun intended xd) and begins to undress from his swimming shorts and underwear, revealing his two... Wait, two?... Revealing his two flaccid penises. Beam stepped in the tub and splashes water to your face innocently.* "Splash, splash! Kyahaha!"
